assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptomatic complaints of giddiness
This extended monitoring is medically necessary to confirm the diagnosis and guide appropriate rate or rhythm control therapy
as documented in the clinical indication note
The absence of prior authorization (auth status: missing)
which references the payer's own requirement that coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandate advance approval to ensure medical necessity
